{{- /* creator/local-graph.html — Base graph capability (caps/graph/graph.js mounts on .graph-container, reads data-cfg; data from search-index.json, search.content=true). Global view via .global-graph-*. */ -}} {{- $local := dict "drag" true "zoom" true "depth" 1 "scale" 1.1 "repelForce" 0.5 "centerForce" 0.3 "linkDistance" 30 "fontSize" 0.6 "opacityScale" 1 "showTags" false "removeTags" (slice) "focusOnHover" false "enableRadial" false -}} {{- $global := dict "drag" true "zoom" true "depth" -1 "scale" 0.9 "repelForce" 0.5 "centerForce" 0.2 "linkDistance" 30 "fontSize" 0.6 "opacityScale" 1 "showTags" false "removeTags" (slice) "focusOnHover" true "enableRadial" true -}} {{- $cfg := .Site.Params.graph -}} {{- if reflect.IsMap $cfg -}} {{- with index $cfg "localGraph" -}}{{- $local = merge $local . -}}{{- end -}} {{- with index $cfg "globalGraph" -}}{{- $global = merge $global . -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}}

{{ i18n "creator.graph" }}
